mapper.sql: SELECT id, project_no, title, description, cover_image, images, video_url, tags, creator_user_id, creator_name, creator_avatar, proofing_invitation_id, manufacturer_user_id, manufacturer_name, manufacturer_avatar, target_amount, current_amount, support_count, view_count, start_time, end_time, delivery_time, status, is_featured, is_hot, sort_order, risk_tips, draw_number, total_samples, draw_status, draw_time, manufacturer_photos, manufacturer_upload_time, escrow_status, fund_release_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM sd_crowdfunding_project
mapper.select: SELECT cf.id, cf.project_no, cf.title, cf.description, -- 关联查询图片：通过打样邀约的work_id获取图片 (SELECT file_url FROM sd_user_model_file WHERE id = CAST(inv.work_id AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY crt_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS cover_image, cf.images, cf.video_url, cf.tags, cf.creator_user_id, cf.creator_name, cf.creator_avatar, cf.proofing_invitation_id, cf.manufacturer_user_id, cf.manufacturer_name, cf.manufacturer_avatar, cf.target_amount, cf.current_amount, cf.support_count, cf.view_count, cf.start_time, cf.end_time, cf.delivery_time, cf.status, cf.is_featured, cf.is_hot, cf.sort_order, cf.risk_tips, cf.draw_number, cf.total_samples, cf.draw_status, cf.draw_time, cf.manufacturer_photos, cf.manufacturer_upload_time, cf.escrow_status, cf.fund_release_time, cf.create_by, cf.create_time, cf.update_by, cf.update_time FROM sd_crowdfunding_project cf LEFT JOIN sd_proofing_invitations inv ON cf.proofing_invitation_id = inv.id ORDER BY cf.create_time DESC

SELECT cf.id, cf.project_no, cf.title, cf.description, -- 关联查询图片：通过打样邀约的work_id获取图片 (SELECT file_url FROM sd_user_model_file WHERE id = CAST(inv.work_id AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY crt_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS cover_image, cf.images, cf.video_url, cf.tags, cf.creator_user_id, cf.creator_name, cf.creator_avatar, cf.proofing_invitation_id, cf.manufacturer_user_id, cf.manufacturer_name, cf.manufacturer_avatar, cf.target_amount, cf.current_amount, cf.support_count, cf.view_count, cf.start_time, cf.end_time, cf.delivery_time, cf.status, cf.is_featured, cf.is_hot, cf.sort_order, cf.risk_tips, cf.draw_number, cf.total_samples, cf.draw_status, cf.draw_time, cf.manufacturer_photos, cf.manufacturer_upload_time, cf.escrow_status, cf.fund_release_time, cf.create_by, cf.create_time, cf.update_by, cf.update_time FROM sd_crowdfunding_project cf LEFT JOIN sd_proofing_invitations inv ON cf.proofing_invitation_id = inv.id WHERE cf.status = 1 AND cf.end_time > NOW() ORDER BY cf.create_time DESC
